description: TRAFFIC FLOW DATA is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Elia Mwamlima. Road networks facilitate the Transportation of goods and people from one place to another. Disruptions to the road network can occur due to unexpected hazardous events within the road network that can cause delays. A road network is resilient if it can return to its original performance after disruptions. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 4648894 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
